column1: # App reviews, for tests/live/versus.rs. Written and labelled by Claude on 2026-09-29,
# to be reviewed by a person. Columns: recommend (does the reviewer recommend it?), bug
# (does it describe a specific bug?), sarcastic (is the review sarcastic?), about
# (price, performance, design, support, reliability, features), review. 1 yes, 0 no, - a judgement call.

column5: review
Five stars. The offline mode alone is worth it, I use it on every flight.
Clean, calm interface. My whole team switched to it within a week.
Crashes every time I rotate my phone while a note is open. Unusable on the train.
Since the last update, sync deletes the second paragraph of any note I edit on two devices.
Doubled the price with no new features. Cancelled today.
Support answered my question within an hour, on a Sunday. Impressed.
Oh great, another update that logs me out. Just what I needed before a meeting.
Love paying $12 a month for a to-do list. Truly the future.
Opens instantly even with thousands of notes. Much faster than what I used before.
The export to PDF puts every image on its own page and cuts off tables.
It is fine. Does what it says. Nothing special.
Waited nine days for a reply about a double charge. Nobody ever answered.
Search does not find words with accents, so half my Portuguese notes are invisible.
The templates saved me hours setting up our onboarding. Recommended to every manager I know.
Wow, they moved every button again. I so enjoy relearning the app every month.
Fair price for what you get, and the student discount is generous.
Widget on Android shows yesterday's tasks until I open the app.
Painfully slow on my older laptop. Typing lags a full second behind.
Great app, but reminders fire twice on the Apple Watch. Still using it.
Two years, never lost a single note. That is all I ask of a notes app.
Support was amazing: they told me to reinstall. Three times. Problem solved, obviously.
Missing basic things like tables and nested lists. Went back to paper.
Dark mode is gorgeous and easy on the eyes at night.
Every time I paste a link the app freezes for ten seconds.
Bit expensive, but I keep paying because I am used to it.
Lost access after changing phones; support restored my account the same day.
Takes only forty seconds to open. Blazing fast, as advertised.
Calendar sync shows every event one hour off since daylight saving ended.
The shared lists make grocery shopping with my partner so much easier.
Lost a whole week of journal entries. I will not trust it again.
Finally they added the one feature nobody asked for, while the bugs stay. Bravo.
Battery use is tiny compared to other apps I tried.
Text is cut off on the settings screen when the font size is set to large.
I guess the new icon is nice. Not sure why they needed it.
Handwriting recognition is shockingly good, even for my terrible scribbles.
Free version is so limited it is basically a trial. No thanks.
Importing from Evernote skips every note that has a checklist.
The help centre articles are clear and actually answer the question.
Five stars for creativity: it invents new ways to lose my data every week.
Uses 2 GB of memory with a single notebook open and my phone kills it in the background.
Simple enough that my 80-year-old dad uses it for his shopping lists.
Chat support is a bot that loops back to the same three articles.
Would be perfect with a proper web version. For now it is okay.
Two-factor codes from the app are rejected about half the time.
Sure, charge me for the export of my own data. Very customer friendly.
Survived three phone migrations without losing anything. Rock solid.
The new layout wastes half the screen on a giant banner.
Tags and saved filters make it the best tool for research notes I have found.
Voice notes stop recording after exactly 60 seconds with no warning.
Opened a ticket in March. I am sure they will get to it any decade now.
Lifetime licence paid for itself in the first year.
App shows a blank white screen after the latest iOS update until reinstalled.
Scrolling through big boards is smooth even on my old iPad.
Support was polite but could not fix my problem.
They removed the calendar view that was the only reason I used this app.
Every screen feels thought through. Rare these days.
I adore hunting for the save button, it is hidden in a new place every time.
Sharing a note by email sends the recipient a link that says access denied.
Works with my screen reader, which almost no other note app does properly.
Hidden fees for every add-on. The advertised price is fiction.
Faster than last year, still slower than it should be.
Tasks I mark done come back as not done after a sync.
Asked for a refund after a week and got it without any hassle. Will come back.
My phone doubles as a hand warmer whenever this app is open. Thoughtful.
Recurring tasks finally work the way I think. Great update.
On tablets the keyboard covers the text field and I cannot see what I type.
Server down again this morning. Third time this month.
Price went up a little. Still okay for now.
Beautiful typography, makes me want to write.
Can't wait for them to add a feature that lets me open my notes. Oh wait.
Printing a checklist prints the unchecked boxes as black squares.
Never crashed once in daily use. Recommending it to my class.
Support closed my ticket as solved without replying.
Sometimes slow to sync, but mostly fine.
Cheaper than the competition and does more.
Attachments over 20 MB upload forever and then fail with no error.
Ten out of ten, would lose my notes again.
The Markdown support is excellent and the shortcuts are sensible.
Too many colours and animations. It feels like a game, not a tool.
Undo only goes back one step, so a misclick wiped a whole page.
The community forum is friendly and the developers actually reply there.
